name: Hammershout the Elder
summary: During the Lunar Festival, Hammershout the Elder appears in Stormwind's Park. Travelers honor the old races and receive a ceremonial token from him.

sections.title: Honoring Ancient Blood
sections.body: During the Lunar Festival, revered ancestor spirits appear across Azeroth with wisdom and blessings for travelers who pay their respects. Hammershout the Elder appears in Stormwind's Park district. His presence near the heart of human civilization recalls the ancient races who walked the land before today's kingdoms rose.

sections.title: Tokens of Ancestral Reverence
sections.body: Hammershout the Elder asks for no trial or oath, only acknowledgment of the past. He is relieved and grateful when people still honor the old races. In return, he gives travelers a ceremonial token, a sign of the bond between the living and the spirits who came before.

faq.answer: Hammershout the Elder is an ancestral spirit who appears during the Lunar Festival. He represents Azeroth's ancient lineages and offers blessings and tokens in Stormwind to those who honor him.

faq.q: Where can Elder Hammershout be found?
faq.answer: Hammershout the Elder appears in Stormwind's Park district during the Lunar Festival.

faq.q: Why does Elder Hammershout mention the 'olden races'?
faq.answer: His words reflect the Lunar Festival's celebration of antiquity and ancestor worship. The festival honors the ancient peoples and traditions that shaped Azeroth before modern settlements rose.

faq.q: What token does Elder Hammershout offer?
faq.answer: Hammershout the Elder offers a Coin of Ancestry, a ceremonial token given by the Lunar Festival spirits to travelers who seek out elders and pay their respects.

faq.q: Can Horde adventurers speak with Elder Hammershout?
faq.answer: Yes. Horde travelers can speak with Hammershout the Elder, though they must tread carefully in Stormwind, the Alliance capital.

faq.q: Is this encounter tied to an active holiday?
faq.answer: Hammershout the Elder appears during the annual Lunar Festival, granting blessings before fading back to the spirit realm.

angles.text: In Stormwind's Park, Hammershout the Elder reminds you to respect Azeroth's history, which reaches back before the modern human kingdom.
When you visit Stormwind's Park, Hammershout the Elder recalls reverence, peace, and the world's shared ancestral past.
To reach Hammershout the Elder, you must enter Stormwind and make your way to the Park, a daring journey for a Horde pilgrim.
